Title: Tanay and the Family

Cast

1. Tanay - 12 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Shalini - 34 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Sharda - 69 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[It is raining heavily. Tanay stands in the courtyard. Shalini stands near him.]

Tanay: "Today feels like a good day."

[Tanay opens his umbrella.]

Shalini (excited): "I knew it!"

[Tanay puts on his raincoat.]

Shalini (surprised): "What a day to remember!"
